text.p: The Multi-Credit Corporation of Thailand Plc has appointed Finance One as lead underwriter and Thai Danu Bank as adviser on a 500 million baht subordinated bond issue due later this month.
This December offer is the first in a series of MCC debentures issues scheduled between now and the end of 1997 aimed at raising a total 3.5 billion baht, the company said.
In a statement MCC, a securities and finance firm, said the initial bond would be offered through private placement.
It will carry a floating rate coupon based on Thai Danu Bank's TDB.BK three month fixed deposit rate which is currently 11.25 percent. The bonds have a maturity of 10 years.
"This debenture issue represents an important milestone in strengthening MCC's funding and reflects a strong commitment to future growth," said MCC President Surakiart Wongwasin.
Further tranches of MCC's bond programme will be issued in 1997 with coupons and maturities determined by market conditions closer to offer dates which have yet to be decided, the company said.
Phatra Thanakit Plc, Nithipat Capital Plc and Securities One Plc will join Thai Danu and Finance One as advisers and underwriters on the later issues, the company said. (US$1 = 25 baht)
